clips.title: The story
paras: The Lorgalis Manuscript lies hidden beneath Ashenvale in the sunken ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. The ancient text concerns the Old Gods, and dark scholars covet its words about powers that sleep.

The Lorgalis Manuscript lies at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps, where long-dead elves once lived before their city fell. Lorgalis wrote of the Old Gods, who raged across Azeroth when the world was new and now lie chained and sleeping. The text praises Aku'mai, a servant of the Old Gods who dwells in the Deeps. Its lore is said to open mystical doorways and stir ancient beings sleeping deep beneath the world. The manuscript rests in a pitted iron chest among the flooded corridors, drawing the attention of cultists and shadow scholars alike.
